## Fixture Coverage

- Schema/alias modes: `src/test/moveAnimationToolingP1P2.test.ts` round-trips every declared enum value and checks all 78 dispatch entries.
- Camera and projection: `src/test/moveAnimationPreviewModel.test.ts` covers presets, side swapping, relative coordinates, angles, projection, waits, and restoration.
- Shadow Ball regression: `src/test/moveAnimationToolingP1P2.test.ts` fixes its opening `AdjustCamera INTERPOLATION_RELATIVE, 3px, 0, 3px, ...` to the Swan-relative pose.
- Particles: `src/test/moveAnimationPreviewModel.test.ts` fixtures cover anchors, projectiles, screen/ortho placement, texture orientation, child emission, behavior, and deterministic ordering.
- Sprite and cleanup: `src/test/gen5BattleSpriteSimulator.test.ts` plus workflow lint fixtures cover affine, palette, opacity, visibility, shadow, freeze, task waits, and terminal restoration.
